name: Your New Life
source: The protagonist, a young man who hasn't moved out yet, is told by his stepmom Lauren that he will need to find a girlfriend he can move in with by the end of the month, or she will "discipline" him. In the meantime, Lauren hires the college student Mari as a babysitter, giving her free reign to treat the protagonist as she sees fit. The protagonist can try to get together with three dominant women who like to humiliate him: Mari; his personal trainer Alexis; and Shawna, the CEO of his workplace.
translation: 主角是一个尚未搬出去的年轻人，他的继母劳伦告诉他，他需要在月底之前找到一个可以搬进去的女朋友，否则她就会“管教”他。与此同时，劳伦聘请了大学生玛丽作为保姆，让她可以自由支配，以她认为合适的方式对待主角。主角可以尝试与三个喜欢羞辱他的强势女性走到一起：玛丽；他的私人教练亚历克西斯；和他工作场所的首席执行官肖娜（Shawna）。
